card.name: Spaces between numbers in tables
card.fires_on: The gap or separator between one number and the next in flattened table rows of doses, counts and percentages. It also fires on a lone digit inside such a number run.

modes.label: Space between table numbers
modes.description: The blank separator between two numbers in a run of table cells.

modes.label: Digit or point inside number run
modes.description: A single digit or decimal point within a string of table values.

card.plain: It marks the gaps between numbers when a table has been flattened into a line of figures.
